paper.title_en: Free hyperboloidal evolution in 3D: gauge waves and constraint-violating gravitational waves
paper.abstract_en: Hyperboloidal evolution allows to reach future null infinity within numerical relativity simulations. This work extends the conformal compactification approach with BSSN/Z4 from spherical symmetry to full 3D simulations. This is the first free numerical hyperboloidal evolution in 3D with a common formulation of general relativity. In this first step, gauge waves and constraint-violating gravitational waves perturbing Minkowski spacetime are evolved nonlinearly and show that the implementation is reliable and signals can be successfully extracted at future null infinity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文将基于BSSN/Z4的共形紧致化双曲演化从球对称推广到完整三维数值模拟，并首次实现三维自由双曲演化，涉及未来零无穷处的信号提取，属于广义相对论基础与数值相对论方法方向，值得点开阅读。
decision.title_zh: 三维自由双曲演化：规范波与违反约束的引力波
decision.abstract_zh: 双曲演化使得在数值相对论模拟中能够到达未来零无穷。本工作将基于BSSN/Z4的共形紧致化方法从球对称推广到完整的三维模拟。这是首次使用广义相对论的一种通用表述进行的三维自由数值双曲演化。在这一初步步骤中，对扰动闵可夫斯基时空的规范波和违反约束的引力波进行了非线性演化，结果表明该实现是可靠的，并且能够在未来零无穷处成功提取信号。
